items.title: ABNB Q3 2026 deep dive: AI-driven product expansion accelerates growth and margin gains
items.summary: Online accommodations platform Airbnb (NASDAQ:ABNB) beat Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q3 2026, with sales up 18.9% year on year to $4.87 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $3.16 per share was 10.7% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
